title: Abatambuze b'ennimiro ya Verdant
intro: Mu biseera eby’edda, abantu babiri ssekinnoomu baali balabirira ettaka eryali liriraanyewo. Amakubo gaabwe gaali gakwatagana, naye ate emitima gyabwe gyabatwalanga mu bifo eby’enjawulo ennyo. Omu yatambulira mu kkubo eggolokofu, ate omulala n’abula mu kizikiza eky’okwegaana. Osobola okusumulula ekyama ky’abakuumi bano ababiri ab’amakungula?
clues: Nnalina ebirime bingi, amakungula amalungi ennyo agaali gazibuwalira amaaso g’abalabi.
Muliraanwa wange yalina eby’obugagga ebisingako n’okusinga nze, naye ate nga nneegomba omugabo gwabwe okusinga ogwange.
Nateesa nti ebirime byabwe tubisaanyizeewo ddala, okunyweza buli kimu wansi w’obuyinza bwange.
Naleeta okuzikirizibwa ku makungula gange nakwo, nga nsaanyaawo buli kimu mu nkwe zange ez’obusirusiru.
Nayimirira nga sirina kye nsobola kukola ng’ebirime byange bikala n’obugagga bwange ne bufuuka enfuufu mu kiro kimu.
Nnali sirina mugabo gwonna mu Akhira, era ekifo kyange eky’enkomerero kyafuuka ekinnya ky’omuliro ogwaka.

identity.label: Nze Ani?
options: Nnannyini ttaka omugagga eyali abulwa kwebaza
Omulimi eyeegomba ettaka lya muliraanwa waabwe
identity.answer: Omulimi eyeegomba ettaka lya muliraanwa waabwe

Obugagga obw’akaseera obuseera nga bugobererwa omuliro ogw’olubeerera
Okuzzaawo mu ngeri ey’ekyamagero n’obulungi obw’emirundi ebiri
outcome.answer: Okusaanyaawo ddala amakungula gombi mu bulamu buno

verse: Then they approached one another, blaming each other. (68:30)
